description: This class includes the manufacture of other products of natural or synthetic rubber, unvulcanised, vulcanised or hardened.
includes: manufacture of rubber tubes, pipes and hoses
manufacture of rubber conveyor or transmission belts
manufacture of rubber floor coverings and mats
manufacture of rubber gaskets, packing and sealing devices
manufacture of rubber latex thread and cord
manufacture of foam rubber and articles thereof
manufacture of hard rubber (ebonite) in any form
manufacture of rubber articles for medical, pharmaceutical, hygienic or toiletry use
manufacture of other rubber products: inflatable rubber mattresses, life-jackets, erasers, teats, hot-water bottles
excludes: manufacture of synthetic rubber in primary forms, see 2013
manufacture of sport goods of rubber, see 3230
manufacture of games and toys of rubber, see 3240
